title: WASS Nominees Pty Ltd - proposed acquisition of Quality Salt Co Pty Ltd.

body_sections.Summary: WASS Nominees Pty Ltd - proposed acquisition of Quality Salt Co Pty Ltd
body_sections.Market definition: The relevant market is the market for the supply of salt in Western Australia.
body_sections.Competition analysis: WASS and Quality Salt both supply salt in south-west Western Australia. The ACCC considers that the potential for salt to be supplied into south-west Western Australia from, for example, north-west Western Australia, where a substantial amount of salt is produced, would be likely to provide a competitive constraint on the merged company. Consequently, the ACCC considers that the proposed acquisition is unlikely to substantially lessen competition in the relevant market.
